translation.name: Luda yã takada kũ Bisã yão

content: Tɑbu kowo be bɑ kɑ Dɑfidi
nɔɔ tiɑ kuɑ Sɔɔlun wɑɑti
Sɑnɑm mɛ Dɑfidi u kpikiru suɑ u dɑ Sikilɑgiɔ u kɑ Sɔɔlu Kisin bii tondɑ, yerɑ gɑbɑ seewɑ bɑ dɑ win mi. Bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɑbu durɔ wɔrugɔbɑ be bɑ sɔɔru sɑ̃ɑ bu kɑ nùn tɑbu somi.
Mɑ bɑ tɛnnu kɑ kpurɑntɛɛnu nɛni. Bɑ mɑɑ ye kpuron tobu yɛ̃wɑ nɔm geu kɑ nɔm dwɑru. Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ, Sɔɔlun bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ,
berɑ tɑbu sunɔ Akiesɛɛ kɑ Yoɑsi be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Semɑ, Gibeɑgiin bibu, kɑ Yesiɛli, kɑ Pelɛti be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Asimɑfɛtin bibu, kɑ Berɑkɑ kɑ Yehu be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Anɑtɔtugibu,
kɑ Yisimɑyɑ, Gɑbɑonigii, wi u sɑ̃ɑ tɑbu sinɑmbu tɛnɑ yen wirugii turo,
kɑ Yeremi kɑ Yɑsiɛli, kɑ Yokɑnɑni kɑ Yosɑbɑdi, Gederɑgii,
kɑ Elusɑi kɑ Yerimɔti kɑ Beɑliɑ kɑ Semɑriɑ kɑ Sefɑtiɑ, Hɑrɔfugii,
kɑ Ɛlikɑnɑ kɑ Yisiyɑ kɑ Asɑrɛli, kɑ Yoesɛɛ kɑ Yɑsobeɑmu, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Koren bwese kɛrɑgibu,
kɑ Yoelɑ kɑ Sebɑdiɑ be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yerohɑmun bibu, Gedorigibu.

Gɑdibɑ sɔɔ, tɑbu durɔ wɔrugɔbɑ bɑ nɑ Dɑfidin mi kpee wɔru gen mi, gbɑburɔ. Bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ be bɑ tɑbu tobu yɛ̃. Mɑ bɑ tɛrɛnu kɑ yɑɑsi nɛni. Bɑ dɑm mɔwɑ nge gbee sinɑnsu. Mɑ bɑ sɑ̃u nge nɛm ni nu wɑ̃ɑ guunu wɔllɔ.
Bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔnu wɔkurɑ tiɑ. Berɑ tɑbu sunɔ Esɛɛ kɑ Abudiɑsi kɑ Eliɑbu kɑ Misimɑnɑ kɑ Yeremi kɑ Atɑi kɑ Eliɛli kɑ Yokɑnɑni kɑ Ɛlisɑbɑdi kɑ Yeremi kɑ Mɑkibɑnɑi.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Gɑdigibu bɑ kɑ sɑ̃ɑ tɑbu sinɑmbu, berɑ mi. Wi u piiburu bo be sɔɔ, wiyɑ u koo tɔmbu wunɔbu (100) tɑbu wɔri. Wi u mɑɑ bo, kpɑ u tɔmbu nɔrɔbu (1.000) tɑbu wɔri.
Berɑ bɑ Yuudɛni tɔburɑ wɔ̃ɔn suru gbiikoo sɔɔ, sɑnɑm mɛ yɑ nim yibɑ sere bɔ̃ɔwɔ. Berɑ bɑ mɑɑ tɔn be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ wɔwi sɔɔ girɑ yen sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru giɑ kɑ yen sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru giɑ.
Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ kɑ Yudɑbɑ ben tii bɑ mɑɑ nɑ Dɑfidin mi kpee wɔru mi.

Dɑfidi u bu sennɔ dɑ, mɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ì n ween nɑ nɛn mi kɑ bwisiku geenu, i kɑ mɑn somi, kon kɑ bɛɛ nɔɔ tiɑ ko. Adɑmɑ ì n ween nɑ i kɑ mɑn sɑmbɑ ko, kpɑ nɛn yibɛrɛbɑ bu kɑ mɑn go sɑnɑm mɛ nɑ ǹ tɑɑrɛ gɑɑ kue, Gusunɔ bɛsɛn bɑɑbɑbɑn Yinni u ye wɑɑwo, kpɑ u sun siriɑ.
Yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔn Hunde u duɑ Amɑsɑi, tɑbu sinɑmbu tɛnɑ yen turo sɔɔ, mɑ u geruɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: Wunɛ kɑ be bɑ nun somimɔn bwɛ̃rɑ yu kpunɔ.
Domi Gusunɔ wunɛn Yinni u nun fɑɑbɑ kuɑ.

content: Mɑ Dɑfidi u bu mwɑ kɑ nuku dobu. Mɑ u derɑ bɑ duɑ win tɑbu sinɑmbun wuuru sɔɔ.

Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛrɑn tɔmbu bɑ Dɑfidi swĩi sɑnɑm mɛ wi kɑ Filisitibɑ bɑ dɔɔ bu kɑ Sɔɔlu tɑbu ko. Adɑmɑ bɑ ǹ Filisiti be somi. Domi ye Filisiti ben wirugibu bɑ wesiɑnɑ, bɑ Dɑfidi girɑwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, u ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ Sɔɔlu win yinnin biruɔ kpɑ u rɑ bu wiru bɔɔri.

Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛrɑgii be bɑ Dɑfidi swĩimɑ sɑnɑm mɛ u gɔsirɑmɑ Sikilɑgiɔ, berɑ Adinɑ kɑ Yosɑbɑdi kɑ Yediɛli kɑ Mikɑɛli kɑ Yosɑbɑdi goo kɑ Elihu kɑ Silitɑi. Be kpuro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛrɑn tɑbu kowo wuunun wirugibu.
Berɑ bɑ Dɑfidi somi domi be kpuro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɑbu durɔ wɔrugɔbɑ kɑ mɑɑ tɑbu sinɑmbu.
Tɔ̃ɔ bɑɑtere, tɔmbu bɑ rɑ n nɑɑmɔwɑ Dɑfidin mi bu kɑ nùn somi sere win tɑbu kowobu bɑ dɑbiɑ bɑ dɑm kuɑ nge Gusunɔn tɑbu kowobu.
Tɑbu sinɑm be bɑ Dɑfidi kuɑ
Isirelibɑ kpuron sunɔ
Tɑbu kowo be bɑ nɑ Dɑfidin mi Heboroniɔ bu kɑ nùn Sɔɔlun bɑndu wesiɑ nge mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u geruɑ, ben geeru wee.
Yudɑn bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ, tɑbu kowo be bɑ tɛrɛnu kɑ yɑɑsi nɛni, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔnu nɔrɔbun subɑ nɔɔbɑ tiɑ kɑ nɛnɛ (6.800).
Simɛɔn bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ tɑbu durɔ wɔrugɔbɑ ben geerɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɔrɔbun subɑ nɔɔbɑ yiru kɑ wunɔbu (7.100).
Lefibɑn bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ, tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ nnɛ kɑ nɑtɑ (4.600) bɑ wɑ̃ɑ,
kɑ Yehoyɑdɑ, Aronin yɛnun wirugii kɑ win tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ itɑ kɑ nɑtɑ kɑ wunɔbu (3.700),
kɑ Sɑdɔku, ɑluwɑɑsi kpɛmbu wi u sɑ̃ɑ tɑbu durɔ wɔrugɔ kɑ wirugibu yɛndɑ yiru be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ win tundon yɛnugibu.
Bɛnyɑmɛɛn bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Sɔɔlun mɛro bisibu, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ itɑ (3.000) domi ben dɑbirɑ bɑ kɑ Sɔɔlu yɔ̃rɑ n kɑ sɑɑ ye girɑri.
Efɑrɑimun bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndu kɑ nɛnɛ (20.800). Bɑ bu gɑrɑ yɛnu kɑ yɛnu. Bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɑbu durɔ wɔrugɔbɑ be bɑ yĩsiru yɑrɑ.
Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛrɑn sukumgibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɔrɔbun subɑ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ itɑ (18.000). Berɑ bɑ sokɑ kɑ ben yĩsɑ bu kɑ dɑ bu Dɑfidi ko sunɔ.
Isɑkɑrin bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɑbu sinɑmbu goobu (200) kɑ sere mɑɑ ben tɔn be bɑ kpɑre. Isɑkɑrin bwese kɛrɑgii be, bɑ ben wɑɑtin ɑsɑnsi yɛ̃ bu kɑ tubu ye Isirelibɑ bɑ koo ko.
Sɑbulonin bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ weerɑɑkuru (50.000) be bɑ tɑbu yɛ̃, bɑ mɑɑ tɑbu yɑ̃ɑ bwese bwesekɑ nɛni, bɑ sɔɔru kpeere bu kɑ tɑbu ko kɑ gɔ̃ru tiɑ.
Nɛfitɑlin bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɑbu sinɑmbu nɔrɔbu (1.000) kɑ sere mɑɑ tɑbu kowobu nɔrɔbun subɑ tɛnɑ kɑ nɔɔbɑ yiru (37.000) be bɑ tɛrɛnu kɑ yɑɑsi nɛni.
Dɑnun bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ, be bɑ tɑbun sɔɔru kpeere, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndɑ nɔɔbu kɑ itɑ kɑ tɔnu nɑtɑ (28.600).
Asɛɛn bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ, be bɑ tɑbu yɛ̃ mɑ bɑ sɔɔru sɑ̃ɑ bu kɑ tɑbu ko, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ weeru (40.000).
Be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yuudɛnin sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru giɑ, Rubɛnibɑ kɑ Gɑdigibu kɑ Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛrɑn sukumgibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ wunɑɑ teeru (120.000). Bɑ mɑɑ tɑbu yɑ̃ɑ bwese bwesekɑ mɔ.
Tɔn be bɑ tɑbun sɔɔru sɑ̃ɑ mi, be kpurowɑ bɑ nɑ Heboroniɔ kɑ gɔ̃ru tiɑ, kpɑ bu kɑ Dɑfidi ko Isirelibɑ kpuron sunɔ. Mɑ Isireli be bɑ tie bɑ kɑ bu nɔɔ tiɑ kuɑ.
Mɑ bɑ kuɑ sɔ̃ɔ itɑ Dɑfidin mi, bɑ dimɔ bɑ nɔrumɔ. Domi begibu bɑ dĩɑnun sɔɔru kuɑ ben sɔ̃.

Yen biru be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ ben bɔkuɔ n kɑ girɑri Isɑkɑribɑ, kɑ Sɑbulonibɑ kɑ sere Nɛfitɑlibɑ, bɑ rɑ ben kɛtɛkunu kɑ ben yooyoosu kɑ ben birɑkɔsu kɑ sere mɑɑ ben kɛtɛbɑ dĩɑnu sɔbimɛwɑ bu kɑ nɑ, kɑ mɑɑ som kɑ figi gbebi, kɑ resɛm gbebi, kɑ tɑm kɑ gum, kɑ kɛtɛbɑ kɑ yɑ̃ɑnu dɑbi dɑbinu, domi be kpuro bɑ wɑ̃ɑ nuku dobu sɔɔ.
Dɑfidi u Yinni Gusunɔn
woodɑn kpɑkororu yi
Obɛdi Edɔmun yɛnuɔ
